pieces.name: Wind-bent pine A
pieces.notes: Broad flat-topped crown: three or four layered needle pads swept to one side (+X downwind). Thick twisted brown-grey trunk leaning hard over, gnarled root flare gripping a few small cragslate stones and a tuft of turf. Needles olive-green with gold-lit tops, teal-shadowed undersides.

pieces.name: Wind-bent pine B
pieces.notes: Taller S-curved trunk, bonsai silhouette: a high main pad plus two or three smaller pads stepping down the downwind side. Same bark and needles as pine A, roots over a low rock chunk. Lean matches pine A so scatter can keep every tree leaning one way.

pieces.name: Juniper A, sprawling
pieces.notes: Stunted, low and wind-combed: twisted pale silver-grey limbs crawling along the ground downwind, dense bright green foliage clumps on top, a few bare dead branch tips at the trailing end.

pieces.name: Juniper B, on rock
pieces.notes: Grows sideways out of a blocky lichen-spotted cragslate chunk (rock included in the mesh). One small green foliage clump, the rest bleached silver deadwood branching up and downwind. Also the dead-snag silhouette of the wild isles.

pieces.name: Cushion plant
pieces.notes: Tight rounded moss-green dome, painted lumpy surface, dotted with tiny white and pink flowers; a few pebbles at its foot.

pieces.name: Alpine flowers
pieces.notes: Small bright clump: deep blue gentian bells, white star flowers and pink sprays on a green leaf rosette, one small stone. Saturated colour point; place in sheltered ledges.

pieces.name: Wind-flattened grass clump
pieces.notes: Long gold-green grass blades combed flat downwind (alpha cards), a few seed heads, one small stone at the root. Leans the same way as the trees.

pieces.name: Turf patch
pieces.notes: Thin alpine turf mat with a ragged torn edge, short green-gold grass and a few tiny white flowers. Lies on bare stone to break up rock surfaces.

pieces.name: Scree pile
pieces.notes: Conical heap of sharp angular grey-blue cragslate shards, larger pieces at the bottom, small chips spilling out. No seams.

pieces.name: Lichen rock
pieces.notes: Plain cragslate, no seams. Rounded-off grey-blue boulder crusted with pale green-white and orange lichen patches, moss tufts at the base.

pieces.name: Cragslate boulder
pieces.notes: Plain cragslate, no seams. Tilted layered slab block, sharp parallel strata running diagonally, flat chunky painted planes, grass tufts in the cracks.

pieces.name: Split boulder
pieces.notes: Plain cragslate, no seams. Two tall leaning slab halves with a clean cleft between them (a small Ironcleft), moss in the joint.

pieces.name: Ledge outcrop
pieces.notes: Plain cragslate, no seams. Stacked horizontal slabs stepping out into a flat shelf, thin turf and tiny flowers on the top, standable top surface.

pieces.name: Natural stair
pieces.notes: Plain cragslate, no seams. Five or six weathered slab steps rising diagonally between two low rock cheeks, grass in the joints (Gale Stair). Treads about 0.3 m rise so it is walkable.

pieces.name: Spire rock
pieces.notes: Plain cragslate, no seams. Cluster of tall sharp vertical blades rising to one pointed peak, smaller shards around the foot; the biome's spire silhouette in miniature.

pieces.name: Cinder rock
pieces.notes: Wild crag only (Cinderkey, Ironreach). Cinder-black, pitted and porous angular block with scorched rust-red patches and a faint gold seam glint. Never on Galeborne isles.

pieces.name: Ore-seam rock
pieces.notes: Wild crag only. Dark cinder-grey layered block cut by bright copper-gold ore seams painted across the strata (emissive-ish highlight, not true glow). Never on Galeborne isles.

pieces.name: Lip segment, cragslate
pieces.notes: Plain cragslate, no seams. Isle edge segment: thin turf with pink and white flowers overhanging layered grey-blue slab ledges that break into hanging points below. The sheet's sideways pine is not part of the mesh: place cg-pine-a/b as a separate piece. Top edge must meet the terrain surface flush; sides tile with copies.

pieces.name: Lip segment, wild crag

ref.label: isle edge: cinder-black ledges with ore seams

pieces.notes: Wild crag. Same footprint as cg-lip, but cinder-black fractured slabs with diagonal copper-gold and pale silver ore seams, dry brownish turf, loose boulders on top, sharper jagged hanging points.

pieces.name: Underside taper, cragslate
pieces.notes: Plain cragslate, no seams (the sheet paints gold seams on it: drop them, the Galeborne crag has none). Downward-tapering stack of stepped grey-blue strata ending in several hanging points, a small juniper growing sideways and a thin spray of falling water (spray is cg-fall-spray, not part of this mesh). Pivot at the tip; the flat top meets the lip.

pieces.name: Underside taper, wild crag

ref.label: underside: dark stepped ledges with ore seams

pieces.notes: Wild crag. Same shape language as cg-underside but cinder-black, more jagged and splintered, glinting gold and silver ore seams running down the ledges; sinking variant sheds a stream of pebbles.

pieces.name: Wind-blown fall

ref.label: thin waterfall off the lip, blown to spray

pieces.notes: Thin white ribbon of water off the lip that frays into drifting mist downwind as it falls; scrolling alpha cards. Also shown on the nature sheet's underside piece.
